title: Board
description: A surface's kickoff board for Discover: the stickies every concerned party put up while the intent formed, in the order they went up, with no record of who wrote them. not-hotdog composes the intent from the board alone, and each revision of the board keeps the earlier stickies as history. One board per intent.

owner.description: The agent that owns the surface (the repo agent)

date.description: The date the board was opened, YYYY-MM-DD

intent.description: Id of the intent this board forms or revises, once one exists

stickies.description: The stickies, in the order they went up. Who wrote each is never recorded, so not-hotdog judges each on what it says.

text.description: One short thought, as it was said

box.description: The Lean UX canvas box it sits in, when placed

research.description: For an unknown: whether a toy proves it (code) or design research learns it (design)
